edits.newText:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CreateOrderResponse } from '#shared/types/order'
import FormInput from '#layers/ui/app/components/form/Input.vue'
import CartSummary from '~/components/cart/Summary.vue'
import UiBadge from '#layers/ui/app/components/UiBadge.vue'
import UiButton from '#layers/ui/app/components/UiButton.vue'
import { navigateTo } from '#app'
import { definePageMeta } from '#app/composables/pages'
import { useProducts } from '~/composables/useProducts'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useNotify } from '#layers/base/app/composables/useNotify'
import { useCart } from '~/composables/useCart'
import { useDiscount } from '~/composables/useDiscount'

definePageMeta({ middleware: 'cart-not-empty' })

await useProducts()
const email = ref('')
const placingOrder = ref(false)
const { notify } = useNotify()
const { lines } = useCart()
const { code } = useDiscount()

async function placeOrder() {
  if (placingOrder.value)
    return

  placingOrder.value = true
  try {
    const order = await $fetch<CreateOrderResponse>('/api/orders', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: {
        lines: lines.value,
        code: code.value ?? undefined,
      },
    })
    notify(`Order placed for ${email.value}`)
    await navigateTo(`/orders/${order.id}`)
  }
  finally {
    placingOrder.value = false
  }
}
</script>
